'''April 2002 Texas tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Horizon Games, Texas on 21 April 2002. [[Keya Saleh]] won it. It is known from Brian Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3602">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02d3602/ wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02], DeckTech (Brian "Bean2213" Wright, 24 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02d3602/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2002
* '''Site:''' Horizon Games, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Keya Saleh]]
